_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• I tan {start_chips} chip nei tur
• Single deck of 52 cards (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• I khel dealer (house) nena
• Each round Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure zui: i post ANTE leh BLIND bets, 2 hole cards dawng, PLAY bets optional siam thei, community cards reveal leh i best 5-card hand dealer nena compare. I goal chu i winnings maximize (i hand tha zawk a nih chuan) leh i losses minimize (i hand chhe zawk a nih chuan).
• Game tan khiang a, i chip 0 a nih leh round tan a nih chuan (LOSS) leh 1000 rounds zo fel leh chip nei (WIN) chuan.

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet every round
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet every round
• PLAY: Optional bet during gameplay. Round chhung, i tan {ante4} (PRE-FLOP a nih chuan), {ante2} (FLOP a nih chuan), leh {ante} (RIVER a nih chuan) siam thei. I tan river a fold thei, hand surrender leh bet siam lo.

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• I tan 2 face-up cards (i hole cards) dawng
• Dealer tan 2 face-down cards (hidden from you) dawng
• 5 community cards face-down initially deal a ni
• Community cards reveal progressively game phases hnu

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer tan at least PAIR (2 cards of same rank) qualify tur, 2 cards in hand leh 5 community cards hmang.
• Dealer qualification betting outcomes affect, hnu deuh thawh leh.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) leh [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, reveals first 3 community cards
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveals first 3 community cards

📋 FLOP:
  • If 4x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-reveals last 2 community cards)
  • If no 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) leh [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, reveals last 2 community cards
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveals last 2 community cards

📋 RIVER:
  • If 4x leh 2x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-proceeds to showdown)
  • If no prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) leh [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, proceeds to showdown
  • [fold]: Hand surrender, ANTE leh BLIND bets lost

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • All cards reveal leh evaluate a ni
  • Best 5-card hand from 7 cards (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets settled according to payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer doesn't qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualifies leh i win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualifies leh i lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected by dealer qualification
  • I win: Bet returned leh additional payout based on hand strength
  • I lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected by dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: I best hand leh dealer best hand
  • I win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • I lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 of same suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive cards of same suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 cards of same rank
  4. Full House: 3 of a kind + 2 of a kind
  5. Flush: 5 cards of same suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive cards
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 cards of same rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs of different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 cards of same rank
  10. High Card: Highest card wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] leh [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] leh [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] leh [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] leh [c]: Check (no additional bet)
• [fold] leh [f]: Fold (hand surrender)
• [skip] leh [s]: Skip to next phase (when no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high cards) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push if dealer doesn't qualify
• BLIND bet can be very profitable with strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch your chip stack! If it goes to 0 leh round tan a nih chuan, i lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE leh BLIND bets are mandatory every round
• PLAY bets are optional leh strategic
• Make sure you input the correct action, leh only one action at a time.
